newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Berger sees turnover doubling - paper.
newsitem.headline: Berger sees turnover doubling - paper.

text.p: Paint company Berger International Ltd expects to double its annual turnover to Singapore $200 million by 2000, the Straits Times newspaper said on Thursday.
It quoted Berger chairman Annuar Senawi as saying the company was well placed to win contracts from a range of big Malaysian companies such as Renong, Proton and Ekran.
Cowie said Berger needed to establish a new manufacturing plant to replace a licencing agreement with Malaysia's Sime Darby Bhd, which will end next year.
"A decision will be made by the end of January and we will have a Malaysian manufacturing capability by the middle of the year," he said.
